changes.summary: Ask the History can now count across the whole record: most trades in a single day, most waiver pickups in a week, who has traded the most.
The trade deadline now follows the Constitution, the Friday before Week 11 at 8:45pm PT, everywhere on the site instead of a fixed Nov 13.
On phones, sorting a roster by a future salary year now switches Dead Money, Total Salary, Salary Cap and Cap Space to that year and labels them with it.
